subject: Re: Status: profiling repro + an integration snag
body:
Team — decisions from today's review.

The integration ships this week default-off, with the optimizer-ordering fix Leilani and Bilal landed; privacy-sensitive teams opt in per job.

Vera's June runs are far enough along to commit headline numbers to the cost memo: at BERT scale we're seeing the DP-SGD clipping overhead cut roughly in half, with peak memory flat across batch sizes — and Csilla signed off on correctness. The memo goes to the privacy council Jun 18, and I'm writing the Q3 OKR proposing default-on for new DP jobs, which needs to land before the Jun 26 lock.

Remaining risk is adoption, not tech: teams distrust anything touching gradients, so the memo leads with the correctness review.

Thanks all — textbook quarter so far.

Zofia
